title: Metric Implementation Report
description: DESIGN-stage hard-gate artifact. Output of metric-implementation-auditor. Derived mechanically from compare_metric_impls.py; verdict BLOCK halts the stage. BLOCKs when two conditions use a different metric impl_ref/spacing/postprocess, OR a metric declared in the profile is missing from a condition. Profile-driven: canonical impl_ref comes from the domain profile.

missing_metrics.description: Metrics declared in the profile but absent from at least one condition

impl_mismatches.description: Conditions or metrics where impl_ref/spacing/postprocess diverged
